item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00486","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C08","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 is a direct and material drafting template for the child. It proposes immediate work by designated technical people on verification and control, gives nuclear-test detection as the central example, and expressly states that the studies would be without prejudice to the parties’ positions on the timing and interdependence of disarmament measures. The child records Soviet partial acceptance of that proposal and carries the same machinery forward by specifying the experts’ composition, meeting place, timetable, reporting deadlines, and United Nations notification. C08 is a strong earlier formulation of the same proposal, while C03 supplies an earlier version of technical studies without commitment, but neither matches the child as closely as C05.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"technical persons be designated to ascertain what would be required to supervise and control disarmament agreements","parent_excerpt":"I proposed that we start our technical people to work immediately upon the practical problems involved. These studies...would include the practical problems of supervision and control","explanation":"Both use designated technical personnel to determine the practical supervision and control needed for disarmament agreements."},{"child_excerpt":"all without prejudice to our respective positions on the timing and interdependence of various aspects of disarmament","parent_excerpt":"I reemphasize that these studies are without prejudice to our respective positions on the timing and interdependence of various aspects of disarmament.","explanation":"This is essentially verbatim, distinctive language linking the proposed technical work to preservation of each side’s political position."},{"child_excerpt":"experts who would immediately begin a study of methods for detecting possible violations of an agreement on the cessation of nuclear tests","parent_excerpt":"why could not designated technical people agree on what would be required so that you would know if we violated an agreement to suspend testing and we would know if you should commit a violation?","explanation":"The child implements C05’s specific example of bilateral technical study into detecting violations of a nuclear-test suspension."},{"child_excerpt":"Experts from our side will be prepared to meet with experts from your side at Geneva","parent_excerpt":"As an effective means of moving toward ultimate agreement...I proposed that we start our technical people to work immediately","explanation":"The child converts C05’s proposed technical process into concrete meeting arrangements, showing structural continuation rather than mere thematic similarity."}]}
